research.title: Visibility-Aware Consistency for Occluded Keypoint Detection
bullets: Investigated whether visibility-aware consistency improves keypoint localization under partial occlusion; developed a training objective separating visible landmarks from synthetically obscured landmarks.
Evaluated localization errors across occlusion patterns and compared visibility weighting against uniform consistency penalties using controlled masking experiments.

research.title: Illumination-Robust Semantic Segmentation Through Appearance Consistency
bullets: Formulated questions about illumination sensitivity in semantic segmentation and led development of feature moment perturbations, patchwise consistency objectives, and confidence-weighted training.

Compared these components under held-out lighting conditions, examining classwise segmentation errors, confidence calibration, and sensitivity to appearance perturbation strength through ablation experiments.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Descriptors
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and gradient descriptors, with standardized preprocessing and distance-based ranking over a shared image collection.

Compared retrieval precision across descriptor choices and dimensionality reduction settings, inspecting failure cases involving viewpoint changes, background clutter, and similar color distributions.

projects.title: Loss Functions for Imbalanced Image Classification
bullets: Implemented a convolutional image classifier with cross-entropy, class-weighted cross-entropy, and focal loss while holding architecture and data partitions fixed.
Compared per-class recall and confusion patterns under controlled class imbalance, examining how loss selection affected minority-class predictions and overall calibration.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Methods for Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, nonlocal means, and a convolutional denoising autoencoder using matched clean images and synthetically corrupted inputs.
Compared reconstruction quality across noise levels using peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation and texture smoothing artifacts.
